title: New growth_districts tunables parsed with lenient jint (silent decimal truncation) instead of the loader's own jint_strict bar
detail: balance.json decimals silently truncate at the load boundary: "seed_weight_city": 4.9 becomes 4 with no error, deviating from the file's documented "new-catalog integer bar" (jint_strict, ODN-10) already applied to sibling fields.
recommended_fix: Parse the growth_districts block with jint_strict (ok=false -> a named load error), matching terminal_spawn_interval_ticks/cap_fraction_permille; add a fail-fast test row with a decimal value.
